title: helianthemum glaucum var. croceum
intro: Helianthemum glaucum var. croceum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a type of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum glaucum var. croceum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic activities, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote tissue repair. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
